acceptance.given: Package A implementation files and their declared repository scope are available for inspection.

oracle.expected: The artifact and scope check confirms Package A adds no model, HTTP request, installer, new dependency service, or automatic execution of package-declared commands.
forbidden: A model, HTTP request, installer, or new dependency service is added.
The check claims runtime security or execution enforcement from static validation.
oracle.observable: A bounded artifact/scope assertion over the Package A standard and declared production implementation, evaluated during the targeted pytest check.

acceptance.then: The check reports a contract failure if any listed addition or automatic command execution is present.
acceptance.when: During the targeted pytest check, inspect the Package A standard and declared implementation scope for the explicit exclusions; do not infer them from validator return values alone.

failure_intents.selector_intent: A planned pytest artifact/scope assertion for Package A implementation exclusions fails when a prohibited addition or automatic package-command execution is present.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add an explicit artifact/scope check that preserves Package A's frozen exclusions; this is a contract guard, not a new runtime feature.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent state or schema change; revert the implementation and its scope assertion together.

slice_hint.state_transition: The targeted artifact/scope check evaluates the declared Package A exclusions against the implementation artifacts.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted pytest check confirms that Package A contains none of the prohibited additions or automatic command execution, while preserving the frozen scope boundary.
